_about: Atmospheric 1980s/1990s-style R&B slow jam. Original lyrics/style, request-formatting example. ~60-75 s of lyrics structure with a 90 s target cap.
title: Velvet Midnight
style: English, atmospheric late-1980s R&B slow jam, warm expressive female voice, close-mic intimate phrasing, electric piano chords, silky synth pads, deep rounded bass guitar, soft rimshot and snare groove, lush hall reverb, slow tempo, 68 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Candlelight across the ceiling
Slow songs on the radio
Hold me like you mean it, darling
Let the midnight take it slow

[Chorus]
Keep the record spinning, spinning
Every heartbeat in the groove
Underneath the velvet heaven
There is nothing left to prove

[Bridge]
Ooh, the night is ours tonight

[Chorus]
Keep the record spinning, spinning
Every heartbeat in the groove
notes: Slow-burn atmosphere; hook repeats at the end on purpose.
